# fetch { #labdata.fetch }

```python
labdata.fetch(spec_text, refresh=False, cfg=None)
```

Get a local path to a result file, fetching it if it is not cached.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**spec_text**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A spec of the form ``[owner/]repo:path[@version]``. Without a version, the latest is used.

<code>[**refresh**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rescan the repositories before resolving the spec.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Config](`labdata.config.Config`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`labdata.config.Config.load`).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Path](`pathlib.Path`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Path of the file in the local cache, ready to pass to a reader.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If `spec_text` cannot be parsed.

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[LookupError](`LookupError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the spec matches no entry, several entries, or no version.

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[FileNotFoundError](`FileNotFoundError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If the file is held in Git LFS and its content has not been fetched into the repository.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Read a result file from another project into a notebook:

```python
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv(fetch("munch-group/xwas:hits.csv@e4f5a6b"))
```
